intro: Dealing with a stinging insect nest in Teaneck? The Best Pest Control NYC provides professional wasp, hornet, yellow jacket, carpenter bee, and ground bee removal services throughout Teaneck and Bergen County. Our licensed technicians locate nests in wall voids, attics, eaves, soffits, and structural wood, treat the colony, remove accessible nest material, and seal entry points to prevent recolonization.
